scripts.ios: rspeedy build && pod install --project-directory=ios && open ios/GymApp.xcworkspace
scripts.android: rspeedy build && ./android/gradlew -p android installDebug && for s in $(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}'); do adb -s $s shell am start -n com.gymapp/.MainActivity; done
